title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode3 With The Tune

meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow! So much equipment...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you buy all of these, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, my dad used to be in the music business, so most of them originally belonged to him...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your dad...?
I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, if I had this much equipment, I wouldn't know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Actually, you'd be surprised...
More often than not, I end up using the same ones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll try something different when I want to achieve a different sound... But I definitely have my favorites since I don't seem to mix well with some of them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, Hoshino, what would you like to ask me? About how to create a melody? Or about using software...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right. Um... I'm having several issues, but I'd like to start by asking you to listen to my song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just need one second to open it on my computer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's about what I have right now.
No matter how hard I try, I can't produce the sound I have in my head...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I played it through one of the speakers at the rehearsal studio we rented the other day, I noticed that it lacked so much depth... I really don't know where to begin fixing it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, Hoshino, I hadn't realized that you were having Miku sing your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, that's right.
I like Miku a lot... And I want to write songs with her if I'm going to do this seriously...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I mean I want to make them using Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That reminds me of how we first met...
We were both hoping to listen to that one creator's new song which also featured Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, there are so many songs that make Miku's voice sound so beautiful on top of being well put together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I really admire the people who can produce those kinds of Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm having so much trouble now that I'm trying to write my own song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Up until now, I've been listening to all these Miku songs made by a variety of people with different feelings... And they've all been wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to try doing that myself now. Unfortunately, things haven't been going very well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just want to let her singing voice shine, so I feel terrible about how I've been making her sing such an incomplete song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I think you deserve more credit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's a bit hard to clearly see what your song is about... However, I did sense a hint of kindness. Like this song was encouraging me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You mentioned how you weren't getting the sound you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That also means you know exactly what you want from your song, so I think all you have to do is keep working on it with that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Can I ask specifically what kind of song you're trying to write?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What kind of song...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I'm writing this song because I want some people I care about very much to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: People you care about very much...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. So, I put a lot of thought into what kind of song they'd like to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that gives them the courage to change themselves and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that'll be a source of support when they're facing their pain to go beyond their limits...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that tells them that they don't have to hold back when I know they're capable of so much more, and that I'll catch up to them someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to write a song that gently encourages those who I care about most...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...
A song that gently encourages them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hadn't thought of saving others like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I understand what you want now.
Now, about the instruments you wish to include...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you plan on playing this song as Leo/need once it's complete?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan...!
I tried choosing sounds based on the instruments that we all play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it sounded so off when I listened to it. I began doubting myself as to how we usually sound...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The guitar sounded fine to me, but the other instruments don't quite seem to fit into your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I knew it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't have much trouble with the guitar since I play it, but for the rest I could only rely on how everyone else sounds while playing their instruments...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That may partly explain why you're not getting what you're looking for, since just a few different sounds can greatly change the overall feel of a song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to say that experience is also important... But that won't exactly help you right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, for now, let's try coming up with a way to make it sound more balanced...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'd like to start taking a closer look. It should be easier to see everything on my computer since it has bigger screens. So, I'll just send the file to myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Alright, it's open.
I'll mute everything except the drums.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
You really know what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is nothing special.
I just moved a few things around on the screen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We'll start working on your song now...
First, let's listen to how the drums sound...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
This is the closest it's sounded to what I initially imagined...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also enjoyed how your vision slowly started coming to the surface as we worked on your song, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you think they'll understand my message...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may need a little more work, but I believe you're on the right track.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As it is, what you're looking for is there. I definitely felt encouraged by your song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now I feel like composing something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? You too...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
How about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That should work...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-That's incredible... You came up with a melody just like that...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Honestly, this is all I really do...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'd like to work on this more.
The first verse might stand out too much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I can make this part sound more subdued...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (W-Wow... It's like she's a professional songwriter...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And she helped establish the foundation for my song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All that's left for me is to use my computer to get it over the finish line!)
